The Quiet Signal

01The theme

From noise
to signal.

More connected than ever.
But are we really listening?

The Noise Paradox explores the tension of our times: an abundance of information, and a growing search for meaning. The Quiet Signal is an invitation to pause, look beyond the obvious, and discover the ideas that stay with us.

The Quiet Signal · Our theme manifesto
MENTAL NOISE

THE MYTH OF BUSYNESS

We've been taught that if we aren't moving, we aren't growing. In a world that constantly demands our attention, we've started believing that the busier we are, the more valuable we become.

We fill our schedules, chase opportunities, and try to keep up with endless expectations, yet often lose sight of what truly matters.

CONSTANT MOTION → REAL VALUE
LIGHTHOUSE PRINCIPLE

THE PARADOX

The more noise we create, the harder it becomes to hear the ideas that matter most. True growth doesn't always come from doing more; sometimes, it comes from slowing down, finding focus, and making space for clarity.

"Like a lighthouse that guides ships without chasing them, meaningful impact often comes from quiet consistency rather than constant activity."
QUIET CONSISTENCY → MAXIMUM IMPACT

What is TEDx?

A TEDx event is a local gathering where live TED-like talks and performances are shared with the community. These events are independently organized by volunteers, but they operate under a free license from TED, following the same spirit of "ideas worth spreading."

Our event, TEDxNITKSurathkal, brings together brilliant speakers and thought-provoking video content to spark deep discussion and create lasting connections right here in our community.

Learn more↗

01When and where is the next event?

The Noise Paradox is the next chapter of TEDxNITKSurathkal. The date and specific venue will be announced here once confirmed.

02How can I register?

Registration details are coming soon. Check this website or our official Instagram for announcements. No ticket prices or booking deadlines have been announced on this site.

03Who can attend?

TEDxNITKSurathkal brings together curious minds from the NITK community and beyond. Eligibility and admission details for the next edition will be shared when registration opens.

04Where can I watch talks from past editions?

Visit our Talk Archives to explore talks from previous TEDxNITKSurathkal editions, or browse Past Editions to discover their themes and speakers.

05How can I partner with the event?

Write to tedx@nitk.edu.in for sponsorship, collaboration and other enquiries. Our organizing team will help you find the right way to get involved.

06Who should I contact about accessibility?

Please email tedx@nitk.edu.in with your access requirements before making travel plans. The team can confirm the arrangements available for the announced venue.
